guides.title: How to Use Coupon Codes When Shopping Online in India
guides.excerpt: A simple checklist for applying promo codes and confirming that the discount is reflected in your order total.
guides.body:
## How to apply a coupon code

1. Choose the product you want and add it to your cart.
2. Open the cart or checkout page and look for a field labelled coupon, promo code, discount code or offer code.
3. Copy the code from the offer listing and paste it exactly as shown.
4. Apply the code and wait for the order summary to refresh.
5. Check the discount line and final payable amount before paying.

## Read the conditions first

A code may require a minimum cart value, a first purchase, a specific product category, an app order or a particular payment method. Some codes exclude sale items or selected brands. If the conditions are not met, the store may reject the code or show no discount.

## If the code does not work

Check spelling, expiry information, minimum spend, product eligibility, account eligibility and payment conditions. Remove excluded products or try a different eligible payment method only if the offer terms allow it. Do not complete the purchase based on the advertised discount unless the final checkout total reflects it.

## A useful rule

Compare the final payable amount, including delivery and platform fees. A large percentage discount is not automatically the cheapest deal.

guides.title: Why Is My Coupon Code Not Working?
guides.excerpt: Common reasons a promo code is rejected and what to check before giving up on the offer.
guides.body:
## Common reasons

- **Expired offer:** The source listing or merchant promotion may have ended.
- **Minimum order value:** Your eligible cart total may be below the required amount.
- **New-user restriction:** The code may be limited to first-time customers or first orders.
- **Product exclusions:** Selected brands, sale items, gift cards or certain categories may not qualify.
- **Payment restriction:** The offer may require a specific bank card, wallet or EMI option.
- **App-only offer:** The code may work only in the merchant's mobile app.
- **Account or location restriction:** Some promotions are targeted or available only in certain service areas.
- **Usage limit:** A limited-use code may have reached its redemption cap.

## What to do

Read the full terms, check the cart total and confirm that the items qualify. Recheck the offer on the merchant's website or app. If it still fails, do not assume the code is valid just because a coupon site lists it.

## Reporting a failed code

If this website provides a report button, share the merchant, code, approximate time and the type of restriction shown. Do not submit passwords, full card numbers, OTPs or other sensitive information.

guides.title: Coupon vs Cashback vs Bank Offer: What's the Difference?
guides.excerpt: Understand three common types of online shopping promotions and how to compare their real value.
guides.body:
## Coupon code

A coupon code is entered during checkout. If accepted, it may reduce the cart price immediately or unlock a specific promotion. It can have product, account or order-value restrictions.

## Instant bank discount

An instant bank offer usually requires an eligible card or payment method. The discount may appear during payment or in the order summary. Check the bank, card type, minimum spend, discount cap and EMI conditions.

## Cashback

Cashback is usually credited after a qualifying transaction, sometimes to a wallet, bank account or rewards balance. It may have a waiting period, exclusions or additional conditions. Treat it as conditional until the provider confirms the reward.

## How to compare them

Compare the final amount you pay now, any later cashback you are genuinely eligible to receive, and any extra fees. Do not add multiple discounts together unless the terms explicitly allow stacking.

guides.title: How to Compare Online Deals Beyond the Discount Percentage
guides.excerpt: A practical way to identify the better offer without being distracted by headline percentages.
guides.body:
## Compare the final payable amount

Start with the same product, model, size or pack quantity. Add delivery, platform, handling and convenience fees. Then apply only the offers you qualify for.

## Check the seller and product details

For electronics, confirm the model number, warranty and seller. For fashion, review size and return terms. For groceries, compare quantity and unit price. For travel, include fees and cancellation conditions.

## Understand the discount cap

An offer advertised as a percentage off may have a maximum discount. For example, a hypothetical 20% offer capped at ₹200 cannot reduce an eligible purchase by more than ₹200.

## Be cautious with urgency

A countdown or 'limited time' label is not proof that a deal is good. Check the stated expiry, compare alternatives and buy only if the product meets your needs.

guides.title: New-User Coupons: Eligibility, Restrictions and Tips
guides.excerpt: What first-order promotions usually mean and why a new-user code might be rejected.
guides.body:
## What is a new-user coupon?

A new-user coupon is a promotion intended for eligible first-time customers or first orders. The merchant decides how eligibility is defined, and it may depend on the account, phone number, payment method, address or order history.

## Before using one

Read whether the promotion applies to the first order, first app order or a specific category. Check the minimum spend, maximum discount and expiry information. Some offers cannot be combined with other coupons.

## Why it may fail

The merchant may not consider the account eligible, the cart may contain excluded products, or the promotion may no longer be available. A coupon listing alone cannot guarantee acceptance.

## Shop responsibly

Do not create duplicate accounts or provide false information to bypass a merchant's rules. Confirm the discount in the final checkout summary.

guides.title: Online Shopping Safety: Using Coupon Websites Carefully
guides.excerpt: Simple checks to protect your account and payment information while looking for discounts.
guides.body:
## Use trusted destinations

When a coupon page sends you to a merchant, check the destination domain before signing in or paying. Be cautious of lookalike domains, unexpected downloads and pages that ask for unrelated personal information.

## Never share authentication secrets

A coupon does not require you to share an OTP, account password, full card details or UPI PIN with a coupon publisher. Enter payment details only on the legitimate payment or merchant flow you intended to use.

## Check the actual offer

Read the conditions and verify the discount in the merchant's checkout. Treat unverified listings as leads to investigate, not as a promise of savings.

## Understand referral links

Some deal websites may earn a commission when a visitor makes a qualifying purchase through a link. Clear disclosure helps users understand how the website may be funded.

guides.title: How We Collect and Label Coupon Offers
guides.excerpt: Learn what the status labels mean and why a listed code may still fail at checkout.
guides.body:
## Source-listed

The offer was found on a source page. This does not prove that the merchant will accept it for every customer or cart.

## Source rechecked

The source page was revisited and the offer was still listed there. This is not the same as testing the code at the merchant's checkout.

## Checkout tested

Use this label only when a real checkout test was completed and the test conditions were recorded. A test may apply only to a particular account, product, location, date or payment method.

## User reported

A visitor reported that an offer worked or failed. User reports are useful signals, but they may not apply to every shopper.

## Expired or unknown

Mark an offer expired only when there is sufficient evidence that it ended. Use unknown when the current validity cannot be established. Offer terms can change, so shoppers should confirm the final discount at checkout.

## Our commitment

We aim to preserve source links, record when information was collected or checked, avoid inventing eligibility details, and correct or hide offers when credible evidence shows they are outdated.

guides.title: Festival Sale Shopping Checklist for India
guides.excerpt: Plan purchases around your needs and compare the total cost during major sale periods.
guides.body:
## Before the sale

Make a list of items you actually need, note the usual price where possible and decide your budget. For expensive items, record the exact model or specification you want.

## During the sale

Compare the same product across sellers, check seller reputation and warranty, and read the coupon conditions. Bank discounts may require a particular card or minimum spend. Check whether a discount applies to sale items.

## Before paying

Review the final order total, delivery charges, return policy, delivery estimate and any EMI costs. Keep the order confirmation and offer terms.

## Avoid impulse purchases

A discount saves money only if the purchase is worthwhile and within your budget. Do not buy an unnecessary item simply because the displayed percentage looks large.

faq.q: Are all coupon codes guaranteed to work?
faq.a: No. Offers can depend on account eligibility, products, location, order value and payment method. Check the status shown on the offer and confirm the discount at checkout.
It means the offer was found on a source page. It has not necessarily been tested at the merchant's checkout.

faq.q: Why does a code work for someone else but not for me?
faq.a: The merchant may apply account-specific, location-specific, product-specific or payment-specific conditions. Your cart may not meet the same eligibility rules.

faq.q: Can I combine two coupon codes?
faq.a: Only if the merchant's terms allow it. Many promotions cannot be stacked with other coupons or selected bank offers.

faq.q: Why is the discount different from the advertised amount?
faq.a: The promotion may have a maximum discount cap, eligible-item restrictions, exclusions or a minimum order value.
Show the actual collection or recheck timestamp stored for each offer. Do not promise a fixed update frequency unless the site reliably meets it.

faq.q: How can I report an expired or failed coupon?
faq.a: Use the report option if available and provide the code and a short description of the issue. Never include passwords, OTPs, full card details or UPI PINs.

faq.q: Does the website receive a commission?
faq.a: If the site uses affiliate or sponsored links, disclose that clearly. Do not claim affiliate relationships unless they are actually in place.

footerPages.body: We help shoppers discover coupon listings, sale offers and practical ways to compare prices across online stores in India. Our goal is to make offer conditions and source information easier to understand. A listing is not a guarantee of acceptance: merchants can change or restrict promotions at any time.

footerPages.title: Contact Us & Report an Offer
footerPages.body: Found an expired offer, incorrect condition or broken destination? Send the merchant name, code or offer title, source page and a short explanation. Please do not send passwords, OTPs, UPI PINs or full payment-card details. Reports help us prioritise rechecks, but an individual report does not guarantee immediate removal.
